title: Half Price and Quiet Beams  (Mitad de precio y vigas silenciosas)

segments.t: Graham sube la bolsa de viaje de Caleb hasta el tercer piso mientras Hannah abre la puerta del ático recién preparado. Todos contienen el aliento esperando el veredicto de Caleb. Escucha primero.
Here we are, sir. Watch your head on this low wooden beam.
Oh... look at the proportions of this timber roof!
Solid oak, eighty years old. Not a single leak.
Because of our mistake, tonight is half price, with breakfast included.
Listen for a second... you cannot hear a single car from the street.
Only the courtyard tree and the rain.
To tell you the truth, I hate noisy first floor rooms. I love this space!
Really? You do not mind the extra stairs?
Not at all! And this wide desk under the window is ideal for my work.
What a relief! Here is your silver key, Caleb.
Thank you both for being honest instead of sending me back into the rain.
Sleep well, sir. Breakfast starts at seven thirty downstairs.
Repasemos ahora la escena línea por línea.
Here we are, sir. Watch your head on this low wooden beam.
'Aquí estamos, señor. Cuidado con la cabeza en esta viga baja de madera.'
Oh... look at the proportions of this timber roof!
'¡Oh... miren las proporciones de este techo de vigas!'
Solid oak, eighty years old. Not a single leak.
'Roble macizo, de ochenta años. Ni una sola gotera.'
Because of our mistake, tonight is half price, with breakfast included.
'Por nuestro error, esta noche es a mitad de precio, con desayuno incluido.'
Listen for a second... you cannot hear a single car from the street.
'Escuchen un segundo... no se oye ni un solo coche de la calle.'
Only the courtyard tree and the rain.
'Solo el árbol del patio y la lluvia.'
To tell you the truth, I hate noisy first floor rooms. I love this space!
'A decir verdad, detesto las habitaciones ruidosas de la planta baja. ¡Me encanta este espacio!'
Really? You do not mind the extra stairs?
'¿De verdad? ¿No le importa la escalera extra?'
Not at all! And this wide desk under the window is ideal for my work.
'¡En absoluto! Y este escritorio ancho bajo la ventana es ideal para mi trabajo.'
What a relief! Here is your silver key, Caleb.
'¡Qué alivio! Aquí tiene su llave plateada, Caleb.'
Thank you both for being honest instead of sending me back into the rain.
'Gracias a los dos por ser sinceros en vez de mandarme de vuelta a la lluvia.'
Sleep well, sir. Breakfast starts at seven thirty downstairs.
'Que duerma bien, señor. El desayuno empieza a las siete y media abajo.'
Escuchemos de nuevo toda la conversación sin pausas.
Here we are, sir. Watch your head on this low wooden beam.
Oh... look at the proportions of this timber roof!
Solid oak, eighty years old. Not a single leak.
Because of our mistake, tonight is half price, with breakfast included.
Listen for a second... you cannot hear a single car from the street.
Only the courtyard tree and the rain.
To tell you the truth, I hate noisy first floor rooms. I love this space!
Really? You do not mind the extra stairs?
Not at all! And this wide desk under the window is ideal for my work.
What a relief! Here is your silver key, Caleb.
Thank you both for being honest instead of sending me back into the rain.
Sleep well, sir. Breakfast starts at seven thirty downstairs.
Lejos de escribir una reseña enfadada, Caleb quedó encantado con las vigas de roble de ochenta años. En la próxima escena volvemos abajo a la recepción. Hasta pronto.
Good night!
